items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: and Erskine Butterfield was playing the new Hammond organ.

ctx.x: Yes. So at Vocalion I made "A Tisket, A Tasket." They wanted to try out a Hammond organ, and they was tryin' me out, too, see. And Cozy was there, Cozy Cole, and Erskine Butterfield was playing the new Hammond organ. And what's that trumpet player...?
